_comment: Edit this list, put the zips under <files>/addons and <files>/packs, then run: node tools/make-catalogs.mjs --files <dir> --base-url http://<file server>/launcher. Entries whose zip is missing are skipped with a warning. Addons must be on client-config/approved-addons.json.

addons.name: XIUI
addons.author: Tirem
addons.description: Modern party list, target bar, player bar and cast bar.

addons.name: LuAshitacast
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: Lua-based automatic gear swapping, like GearSwap for Ashita.

addons.name: tHotBar
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: On-screen hotbars for abilities, spells and items.

addons.name: tCrossBar
addons.author: Thorny
addons.description: Controller-friendly crossbar, great on the Steam Deck.

addons.name: statustimers
addons.author: Heals
addons.description: Timers for buffs and debuffs on you and your target.

addons.name: TargetLines
addons.author: jyouya
addons.description: Draws Final Fantasy XII style target lines during combat.

packs.name: Combined Maps: HD
packs.description: Combined in-game maps in high resolution.

packs.name: XI View: Widescreen
packs.description: Updated interface graphics laid out for widescreen.
